name: Shijuu Hachi (kari)
source:
One day, you get a telephone call.
"You've won a chance to test a new game, please tell me about yourself."
And you tell the person on the phone everything about yourself and your family. 
After a while you receive a game called Shiju Hachi. 
Ever since starting the game strange things have started happening around you.

[Edited from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%9B%9B%E5%85%AB%EF%BC%88%E4%BB%AE%EF%BC%89]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
一天，你接到一通电话。
‘你获得了测试一款新游戏的机会，请告诉我关于你自己的事情。’
于是，你向电话另一端的人讲述了自己与家人的一切。
一段时间后，你收到一款名为《四八（暂定）》的游戏。
从启动游戏的那一刻起，怪事便接连发生在你身边。

[编辑自[url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%9B%9B%E5%85%AB%EF%BC%88%E4%BB%AE%EF%BC%89]Wikipedia[/url]]
